experiment_data.hypothesis: Entity quality information (in_gold vs not) is encoded in the fine-tuned model's last-layer hidden states at entity token positions. If probe AUROC ≈ MV AUROC (0.87), the signal exists in representation but ESJ prompt-based reading (AUROC=0.51) fails to access it — a prompt interface failure. If probe AUROC ≈ 0.51, the information is genuinely absent from single-sample representations.
